label: school

specialist_slot.note: Wizard: "an additional spell slot of each spell level he can cast, from 1st on up", filled each day with a spell of the specialty school from the spellbook. An entry with slot: false (the universalist) has none.

opposition.note: Wizard: an opposition-school spell can be prepared, but takes two slots of its level (a cantrip, two cantrip slots).

_source: Core Rulebook, Wizard: Arcane Schools (legacy.aonprd.com/coreRulebook/classes/wizard.html, raw HTML read 2026-10-05; d20pfsrd's classic arcane schools cross-checked). The specialist's extra slot and the opposition schools' double cost are rules/casting.py's; this file is what the school powers DO.

powers.name: Resistance
powers.line: Resist 5 against one energy, chosen each morning (10 at 11th, immunity at 20th).
not_yet: Choosing the energy each morning: no daily pick is asked yet, so the resistance does not land.

powers.name: Protective Ward
powers.line: A 10-ft ward for Int rounds: you and allies inside gain +1 deflection to AC (+1 per five levels), 3 + Int times a day.

powers.name: Energy Absorption
powers.line: Absorb three times your level in energy damage a day, after resistance and immunity.
not_yet: Absorbing damage from the pool: the damage path spends no pool yet.

powers.name: Summoner's Charm
powers.line: Your summonings last + half your level rounds (min 1).
not_yet: Summoning durations: summons are narrated by the cast op.

powers.name: Acid Dart
powers.line: Ranged touch, 30 ft: 1d6 acid + 1 per two levels, 3 + Int times a day.

powers.name: Dimensional Steps
powers.line: Teleport up to 30 ft per level a day, in 5-ft steps, without provoking.
not_yet: Spending feet to move has no op yet.

powers.name: Forewarned
powers.line: + half your level (min +1) on initiative, and you always act in a surprise round.
not_yet: Acting in every surprise round: surprise is not modelled.

powers.name: Diviner's Fortune
powers.line: Touch: + half your level (min +1) insight bonus on attacks, saves, skill and ability checks for a round, 3 + Int times a day.
not_yet: The bonus on skill and ability checks: no 'every skill' target yet.

powers.name: Scrying Adept
powers.line: Always aware of scrying; your own scrying works as if you knew the subject better.
not_yet: Scrying is narrated, not modelled.

powers.name: Enchanting Smile
powers.line: +2 enhancement on Bluff, Diplomacy and Intimidate (+1 per five levels).

powers.name: Dazing Touch
powers.line: Melee touch: a living creature is dazed for a round (none with more Hit Dice than your level), 3 + Int times a day.
not_yet: Sparing a creature with more Hit Dice than your level: no field compares Hit Dice yet.

powers.name: Aura of Despair
powers.line: A 30-ft aura for your level in rounds a day: enemies inside take -2 on ability checks, attacks, damage, saves and skill checks.
not_yet: The -2 on ability and skill checks: no 'every skill' target yet.

powers.name: Intense Spells
powers.line: Evocation spells that deal hit point damage deal + half your level (min +1) more, once per spell.
not_yet: Adding to a spell's damage: the cast op rolls the spell's dice as its prose says and reads no tag of the caster's.

powers.name: Force Missile
powers.line: A missile of force that never misses: 1d4 + your Intense Spells bonus, 3 + Int times a day.

powers.name: Elemental Wall
powers.line: A wall of acid, cold, electricity or fire (as wall of fire) for your level in rounds a day.
not_yet: A wall on the map: a lasting area has no op for a power yet.

powers.name: Extended Illusions
powers.line: Your concentration illusions last + half your level rounds after you stop.
not_yet: Spell durations: illusions are narrated by the cast op.

powers.name: Blinding Ray
powers.line: Ranged touch, 30 ft: blinded for a round (dazzled instead if it has more Hit Dice than your level), 3 + Int times a day.
not_yet: Dazzled instead of blinded for a creature of more Hit Dice than your level: no field compares Hit Dice yet.

powers.name: Invisibility Field
powers.line: Swift action: greater invisibility on yourself for your level in rounds a day.

powers.name: Power over Undead
powers.line: Command Undead or Turn Undead as a bonus feat, channelling 3 + Int times a day for it alone (DC 10 + half your level + Cha).
not_yet: Choosing the feat and channelling for it: no pick is asked, and the channel executor serves a cleric's channel only.

powers.name: Grave Touch
powers.line: Melee touch: a living creature is shaken for half your level in rounds (min 1), 3 + Int times a day.
not_yet: Frightened for one already shaken: the touch lands its shaken only.

powers.name: Life Sight
powers.line: Blindsight 10 ft that sees the living and the undead (20 ft at 12th, +10 per four levels), for your level in rounds a day.
not_yet: Blindsight from a power: senses are read off race and creature documents only.

powers.name: Physical Enhancement
powers.line: +1 enhancement to Strength, Dexterity or Constitution, chosen each morning (+1 per five levels).
not_yet: Choosing the score each morning: no daily pick is asked yet, so the bonus does not land.

powers.name: Telekinetic Fist
powers.line: Ranged touch, 30 ft: 1d4 bludgeoning + 1 per two levels, 3 + Int times a day.

powers.name: Change Shape
powers.line: Beast shape II or elemental body I (III or II from 12th) for your level in rounds a day.
not_yet: A new body: polymorph has no executor yet.

powers.name: Hand of the Apprentice
powers.line: Your melee weapon flies 30 ft to strike as a thrown weapon, Int instead of Dex on the attack, 3 + Int times a day.
not_yet: The flying strike: an attack with a melee weapon at range, rolled off Int, has no field yet.

powers.name: Metamagic Mastery
powers.line: Apply a metamagic feat you know without raising the spell's level, once a day (+1 per two levels beyond 8th).
not_yet: Metamagic: the cast op applies no metamagic feat yet.
